summary: Cardiol Therapeutics Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on the TSX and Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K furnishing eight exhibits—a Master Services Agreement with Dalton Pharma Services plus related development, supply, and assignment agreements dated 2017–2020. The filing discloses no special-situation event; it is an ordinary contract-exhibit submission covering API manufacturing and supply arrangements. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date appears. The registrant is the filer and counterparty. No deal terms, overhang, or regulatory clock; no risk-arb angle.
